checks.name: Anonymous sees both entry actions immediately
Clinical panel is a visible anchor for blocked documents
Narrow viewport has no horizontal overflow
Pending registration does not prematurely return
Completing registration returns to the QR with authenticated identity
Authenticated identity still requires owner permission
Logout clears identity and restores sign-in actions
Login also returns to original record

scope: Real React panel and return hook in Chrome, narrow viewport; simulated auth and clinical APIs. Existing Core registration/login forms reused, no live signup or native-device test.
